title: Detail Service Work Order Form
subtitle: Vehicle Detailing Service: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Detail Service Work Order Form covers vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature. The detail service advisor records Vehicle Detailing Service authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Detail Service Work Order Form keeps Vehicle Detailing Service exceptions visible until the detail service advisor handoff.
use_case: Use Detail Service Work Order Form at detail bay, wash area, interior work zone, drying area, and delivery point. Document vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature identity before Vehicle Detailing Service begins. Compare vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature findings with stated Vehicle Detailing Service criteria; route unresolved Vehicle Detailing Service issues to vehicle appearance quality reviewer.
